BiblicalUsage: Anammelech is named once, as one of the gods of Sepharvaim: the Sepharvites burnt their children in fire to Adrammelech and Anammelech, the gods of Sepharvaim. He was an Assyrian god, brought into the land of Israel by the people settled there after Samaria fell, and his worship cost children their lives.
TheologicalSignificance: A false god named once still shows the truth about idolatry: the Sepharvites burnt their own children to Anammelech, and I believe that is what false gods always demand in the end — the most precious thing you have.
